text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on St. Clair Avenue West, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement an accessible loading zone on the south side of St. Clair Avenue West, west of Christie Street, fronting the St. Matthew's Bracondale House, 707 St. Clair Avenue West. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curb side access for Wheel-Trans vehicles and patrons.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of St. Clair Avenue West, between a point 66 metres west of Christie Street and a point 15 metres further west. 2. City Council designate an accessible loading zone to operate all times, except from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, except public holidays, on the south side of St. Clair Avenue West, between a point 66 metres west of Christie Street and a point 15 metres further west.
